classification: MODEL_VARIANT / fixed native square, two dynamic single-letter contacts and one persistent repair queue
required_input: Two verified positive T05 outcome histories, original B=4. Formal T05 result acceptance is separate.

fixed_arms.AB: ID0 at A, side 0, port 0, A mode
fixed_arms.AD: ID1 at A, side 0, port 2, A mode

dynamic_arms.BC: side 1 at C, port 3, D when present
dynamic_arms.CD: side 0 at C, port 1, D when present

noise: 0 <= delta <= 1; lambda=delta/49 per currently bound dynamic arm. A tick begins by selecting at most one of the up arms with marginal lambda each.
release_tick: Detach precisely the bound ID at C. Enqueue its actual edge and ID. No current service progress or approval is erased; no service on this tick.
no_release_tick: Idle if queue empty; otherwise serve the oldest released ID for one phase.
head_phases: free at C, return to D
free at D, return to A
free at A, outbound to B
free at B, outbound to C
free at C, birth decision success 1/49 or stay
free at C with approval, reserve ID
held at C, commit the specified edge in D mode
second_release: The later ID waits free at C until first binding completes. The first job's phase and inventory are retained.
graph_observer: At the end of every tick on the source-identified bound graph: disconnected iff both BC and CD absent.
time: One explicit damage, service, denied-decision or idle tick; no physical-time calibration.
regeneration: The same physically bound full state with the same assigned identities and no pending service. A generic success observation does not imply regeneration.
excluded: full geometric motion or original 438-label scheduler
a proof for all T05 outcomes
